title: rapanea stolonifera
intro: Rapanea stolonifera, commonly known as the Māori pepper or New Zealand pepper tree, is a species of plant that belongs to the heath family and is native to New Zealand. This plant has been traditionally used in Maori medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and provide anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rapanea stolonifera include its use as an expectorant to relieve congestion, and its ability to act as an antispasmodic to soothe muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Rapanea stolonifera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
